hypothesis: Index-related forced sales may cause temporary pressure in deletions, followed by reversal. This is a hypothesis, not a causal claim.
scope: All four 2024 Taiwan 50 scheduled reviews, all additions/deletions; reserves and other indices excluded
source_policy: Save exact current issuer HTML, HTTP metadata, archive and verified Windows backup/readback before price diagnostics. Displayed historical timestamp is a source claim, not first-publication or revision-history proof.
source_gate: All four scoped sections parse unambiguously, date order valid, balanced additions/deletions, no duplicate or cross-index/reserve contamination; gaps retained, no replacement events.
historical_pit_gate: Not established by current pages; always false in this pilot. No valid historical signals, causality, alpha or prospective performance claims.
primary_cohort: All Taiwan 50 deletions; additions are a prespecified descriptive comparison, never a pool to select the winning side.
entry: Second market session on or after the declared effective-from date, at proxy open; never publication-day close or implementation auction. This additional session delay does not repair unknown revision history.
exit: Close of the 20th market session including entry; full market clock, no compression/drop of missing quotes.
benchmark: 0050 over identical entry/exit market dates, same hypothetical proportional cost each side. Quote endpoints only, no portfolio NAV or annualization.
sample_status: 2024 prices used in older research, not untouched holdout. Four review clusters cannot establish reproducible excess return.
continuation_gate: Source/endpoint coverage complete, at least 3 of 4 quarter deletion cohort mean net-relative quote changes >0 and pooled deletion median >0 at primary cost. If failed, close without tuning; if passed, only a separately frozen independent-event proposal, never daily validation.
